version from Git.  If the latest version fails, report the problem to the
<PRESIDIO_ANONYMIZED_EMAIL_ADDRESS> mailing list or IRC #ffmpeg on irc.libera.chat.
Include the log file "ffbuild/config.log" produced by configure as this will help
solve the problem.", "A": "Clang can't make an executable. If it's a cross-compiler, try the --enable-cross-compile flag, but only if you actually know what cross-compiling is. If the latest version also fails, please report the problem to the mailing list or the #ffmpeg channel on irc.libera.chat. Ensure you include the 'ffbuild/config.log' file produced by configure, as this will assist in resolving the issue."}
